Commentary.Commentary: Mehidy Hasan was good with the ball for Bangladesh upfront. The wily Shakib was very effective as well, as he picked a couple of wickets. The change of pace from Mustafizur Rahman at the fag end proved to be handy, giving him two wickets too. It won't be an easy chase but the Bangla Tigers do have a potent batting line-up. Can they stand tall again to seal the series? Or will the Men from the Caribbean level things up? Join us shortly.

The top order batsmen got starts but couldn't convert them into something significant. Then, the 103-run stand between Hetmyer and Powell steadied the ship. However, the home side lost the plot somewhat after the latter departed, losing 6 for 66 to eventually get bowled out with three balls remaining. If it was not for the effort of Hetmyer, the hosts would have finished below par.

The hosts will be pleased with 271 on the board. It is a two-paced track and there were many occasions when the batsmen found it difficult to time the ball. Shimron Hetmyer was in a different league though. His swashbuckling ton has given the Windies more than a ray of hope.

OUT! Full ball outside off, Hetmyer squeezes it towards deep point and calls for the second. However, a good throw from Mehidy Hasan means that Shimron is struggling. Rahim takes the bails off and appeals. It is taken upstairs. The replays show that the southpaw is just short. End of a brilliant knock from him. WINDIES ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 271!

SIX! Bang! Hetmyer pre-meditates as he feels it will be a full delivery. It is so and he is able to get underneath it to smack it over cow corner for another maximum, the 7th of his innings to be precise.
Rahman is right on the money as he bowls it in the blockhole outside off. Hetmyer targets his favourable region that is mid-wicket with a swipe but misses.
Full ball attacking the stumps, turned around the corner for a run. A poor over from Rubel, 22 from it.
This time gets it right as he bowls it full on middle, tapped towards covers to rotate strike.
Wide! Hossain bowls a full ball down the leg side, Joseph fails to put bat to ball. The second wide of the over.
Chips this one over mid on for a run.
Low full toss outside off, drilled towards sweeper cover for a brace.
No ball! Hossain continues to be off radar. Bowls a high full toss outside off, Shimron plays it through mid-wicket for a run. No ball signaled for height. Free Hit coming up...
Mortaza is giving some words of advice to his bowler. Seems to have run out of ideas.
SIX! In the arc, out of the park! Short ball again, Hetmyer nails the pull over square leg for the second biggie of the over.
Wide! Well outside off, goes past the blade of Shimron.
SIX! Boom! This young man has been a revelation today. Short ball in line of the stumps, Hetmyer gets into a good position and pulls it in front of square leg to clear the fence.
Angling across the No. 11 who swings again but misses for the fourth occasion. Brilliant over from the Fizz, a wicket and only one from it.
Rahman pulling off all the tricks up his sleeve with ease. This time he bowls the leg cutter to bamboozle Joseph.
Another off cutter, the No. 11 once again feels for it and misses.
Outside off, a play and a miss from Joseph.
Alzarri Joseph is the last man in.

OUT! Chopped on! Another one bites the dust! Slower delivery, an off cutter outside off. Doesn't bounce much as well. Bishoo feels for it but gets an inside edge which deflects onto the stumps. Bangladesh will be aiming to bowl out the hosts before the allotted quota of overs.

There it is, the second ODI ton for Shimron Hetmyer! Fullish ball outside off, Hetmyer reaches out and slices it behind backward point for a run. He jumps in joy and fists his pump. What a moment for the youngster. It has been a brilliant knock from him and he deserves every bit of the applause. He becomes the youngest Windies player to score a century at home. Sinks in all the applause.
Fullish ball around off, driven nicely to mid off.
Devendra Bishoo comes out to bat.

OUT! The Windies are losing wickets in a cluster towards the fag end. Good length ball outside off, Paul plays away from the body as he tries to place it through point perhaps but gets a faint outside edge. Another easy catch for Mushfiqur Rahim.
On a length outside off, Keemo tries to poke at it but misses.
FOUR! He has connected well there! Short ball, Paul lines it up and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, mistimed push to cover-point.
Fuller length ball on middle, Hetmyer clips it through wide mid on and sets off. Wants the second to reach his ton but will only get one. Nervous moments for him.
Keemo Paul comes out to bat. Meanwhile, Rubel Hossain returns.

OUT! The slower delivery working wonders for Rahman! He bowls an off cutter well outside off, Nurse goes for the pull across the line but only manages to get a top edge. The ball flies towards third man. Tamim Iqbal stationed there takes it nicely. A wicket and 4 off the over.
Another low full toss, right near the tramline. Hetmyer reaches out to it to place it through cover-point. A run taken. Intelligent bowling from Rahman.
Stays back and guides the length ball past point to rotate strike.
Well bowled! The leg cutter from the Fizz, Nurse tries to hit it through the line but only connects with thin air.
Low full toss well outside off, Shimron reaches out for it and edges it to third man for a single.

Safe! Full ball outside off, Nurse squeezes it out towards backward point and sets off. The fielder moves to his left, collects the ball and hits the bull's eye at the striker's end as Hetmyer strides in to make his ground. It has been taken upstairs. The replays show that the batsman is fine.
Another run out appeal has been taken upstairs. Seems touch and go.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on.
Full length ball, drilled through the same region for a couple.
Good batting! Hetmyer plays this length ball with soft hands through the vacant wide mid on region. Another brace results.
A well-executed yorker from Hossain, Hetmyer is equal to the task as he jams it out through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Full ball outside off, Ashley swings at it but misses.
Leg bye! On middle and leg, Shimron fails to clip it away as the ball brushes his pads and rolls to the leg side. A run taken.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Slow through the air, kept out watchfully.
Ashley Nurse comes out to bat.

OUT! Holder has gifted his wicket away! The experience of Shakib coming to good use. He dropped a catch in the last over but will be happy to take a wicket now. Holder comes down the track even before Shakib has bowled it. That allows the bowler to bowl it a bit wider and it goes past the attempted slog of Jason. Rahim behind the stumps does the rest. The Windies are losing a bit of gas.
SIX! Going, going, gone! Tossed up ball, Holder clears his front leg and tonks it down the ground for a biggie. Has made his intentions clear from the word go.
Outside off, tapped past point for a single. Hetmyer moves onto 90.
FOUR! Hit with authority! Shorter in length outside off, Hetmyer rocks back and cuts it over covers to find the fence.
Full ball outside off, eased to covers.

Safe! Poor use of the review from Bangladesh! Fuller length ball around leg stump, Hetmyer tries to flick it but is hit on the pads. Hossain roars in an appeal but the umpire stays put. He convinces his skipper to take the review to which he agrees. Time for the replays. The Hawk Eye shows that the ball has pitched outside leg stump and the argument has been put to bed.
Bangladesh feel that they have trapped Hetmyer in front of his crease. Mortaza after a chat with his bowler takes the review. Looks like it has pitched outside leg though.

Dropped and SIX! Shakib will be kicking himself. Shortish ball in line of the stumps, Hetmyer mistimes his pull over mid-wicket. There is more elevation on it rather than distance. The all-rounder goes back and seems to have it covered. He gets his hands to it but fails to hold on. To add insult to injury, he parries the ball over the ropes. Should have gone reverse cup there.
Another inswinger, tailing in. Holder gets an inside edge past his stumps and towards fine leg. Hossain is appealing but the batsmen take a run. There was certainly bat involved.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
The skipper, Jason Holder comes out to bat.

OUT! Bowled 'em! A wicket against the run of play. An important breakthrough for Bangladesh. Fullish delivery, tailing in from around off. Powell clears his front leg and tries to heave it across the line but gets an inside edge which goes onto disturb the furniture behind. The 103-run stand has been broken and a well-compiled knock from Rovman comes to an end.
The arm ball from Shakib, hit down to long on for a run. 12 from the over, these two will be aiming to tee off.
Fuller delivery on middle, eased to long on to rotate strike.
Slower through the air, kept out watchfully.
Punched off the back foot Shimron. They pick up a couple to bring the 100-run stand between these two. How many more can they add?
SIX! Clean as a whistle! So much nimble on his feet. Tossed up ball well outside off, Hetmyer skips down the track and smokes it over wide long off for a maximum. He is playing a gem.

Heart in the mouth moment for Hetmyer! Shorter in length, Shimron places it towards long off and calls for a couple. He is cruising towards the danger end as Sabbir returns a good throw to Shakib. However, he fails to collect the ball properly and that helps Powell to make his ground. The replay shows that if Shakib collected it properly, Rovman was a goner. He looks in some pain too, maybe has has stretched his hamstring.
Shakib Al Hasan is back on to roll his arm. His figures read 7-1-22-1 till now.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
SIX! HUGE! All muscle on that. Too full from Mortaza on middle, Hetmyer gets under the ball and sails it over mid on for a huge hit.
Pulls this through mid-wicket and gets another easy run.
The batsman tried to sweep that one but missed it and was hit on the pads. They pick up a single. Leg byes given by the umpire.

NOT OUT! Powell is safe. Taps this ball towards short cover and hares for a quick single. Mortaza runs towards the ball, turns and hits the bull's eye at the non-striker's end. The umpire takes it up but the replay shows Powell's late stride saves him.
A run out appeal against Rovman Powell is taken up. Looks to be safe. Let's see.
Gets it from the inner half towards mid on for one.
Time for Powerplay 3! Maximum of five fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
FOUR! Slower short ball on off, Powell stays back and pulls it over mid-wicket for another boundary. 10 runs off the over and 10 overs left to go.
Played to the point region by Hetmyer. They pick up a single.
Slower ball outside off, cut to the off side.
Full again, hit along the turf straight back with some force. Long on cuts it out and keeps the batsmen to one.

FOUR! Slashed away and slashed hard. Fuller ball outside off, Powell reaches for it and slices it over backward point. The fielder in the deep puts in a dive but cannot stop the ball from touching the fence.
RP drives this through the covers.

Bangladesh have not been their best on the field today. Fuller ball on the pads from Mortaza, Hetmyer plays it in the gap with soft hands towards mid-wicket. The fielder was a bit deep which enables them to get a couple.
Shimron has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

In the air... and just ahead of Mehidy Hasan. He is living dangerously is Hetmyer. Doesn't pick up the cutter and slices another one over mid off. Mehidy backtracks and dives to his right but cannot reach the ball. Two more runs taken.
Plays this with soft hands towards mid-wicket. Mehidy Hasan does not collect the ball well and the batsmen make it to the crease.
Pushed to the cover region by Hetmyer. The batsmen have run through for a single.

In the air...but safe. Length ball outside off, Hetmyer slices this over the mid off region. Tamim Iqbal hares towards the ball from mid off but cannot make it in time. The batsmen have enough time to come back for the second. Well, Mortaza is lazy there as the ball goes past him. The fielder from the deep runs in to deny an extra run. The skipper needs to be alert. The fielding has been below par from the visitors.
Back of a length ball on the pads, tucked away for nothing.
Using all his experience is Mustafizur. Bowls an off cutter outside off, Powell tries to cut it but fails.
Cutter again, pushed towards mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Angles this away from Powell who gets an edge through to the vacant slip region for one.
Slower ball outside off, defended off the back foot.
Full on middle and off, hit to mid on for a single.
Whipped away through the mid-wicket region. The fielder there runs after it but returns a poor throw which enables them to complete the second.

50 for Hetmyer! The local boy is showing what he is capable of. A pretty well-paced knock from him and he will be eyeing a big one. His second fifty in back-to-back games. Once again checks his shot and pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Back of a length ball on leg, Hetmyer controls his pull shot to cow corner for another brace. Good work in the deep. He moves to 49 now.
Slower ball outside off, Hetmyer closes his bat face early and gets a soft leading edge back towards the bowler. Mortaza gets low but it falls well short of him.
Short ball on middle and leg, Hetmyer pulls it through mid-wicket. A good effort from the fielder in the deep restricts it to two.
Mashrafe Mortaza will continue his spell.
Superb bowling from the Fizz. Ends the over by bowling another cutter outside off. Powell swings and misses. Just a run from the over.
Gets behind the ball this time and hits it back towards the bowler.
Another swing and miss. Powell is not picking up Rahman. Angles this away from the batter who cannot put bat to ball.
Slower cutter outside off, Powell plays and misses.
Wild swing but cannot get any connection with the bat. Cutter outside off, Powell swings and misses. You don't need to play these shots this time of the innings.
Another quick single. Fuller ball on off, driven to mid off as the batsmen set off. Rubel collects the ball and hits his target at the non-striker's end. Hetmyer is safe though.
Drinks break! The artificial lights have started to take effect. Meanwhile, Mustafizur Rahman comes back for a bowl.
Fuller ball on the pads, flicked away to the on side. Dot ball.
Length ball around off, Powell is happy to defend it.
Powell has flicked the ball off his pads.
Looks to drive this to the off side but gets an inside edge onto his pads back towards the bowler.
Works this fuller ball through square leg for one more.
Length ball outside off, Powell hits it through covers for a run which brings up the 50-run stand between these two.
Mashrafe Mortaza returns for a bowl.
Pushes this ball to the mid on region. Another misfield from Bangladesh, this time from Mehidy, to allow an extra run to the total. 12 from the over, the biggest of the innings so far.
Powell rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
FOUR! This time it is Powell and looks like Windies are cutting loose now. Gets under the ball and slog sweeps this over square leg for a boundary.
RP goes back and punches it to covers.
Hetmyer works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
SIX! Welcome to the crease, Hossain! Starts off by bowling a short ball on leg, Hetmyer makes good connection and pulls it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Mosaddek Hossain comes back into the attack.
Waits for the ball and punches it through the vacant mid off region for another single. Mehidy Hasan finishes off with brilliant figures of 10-3-40-1. He was right on the money from the word go.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and flat outside off, Hetmyer cuts this square of the wicket for one more.
Comes down the track and hits this to long on for an easy single.
Uses his wrists and whips this ball through square leg for a brace.
The batsman has been struck on the thigh pad. They pick up a single. A leg bye given by the umpire.
Corrects his length by bowling it a little more full. Hetmyer hits it through mid off for one.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched to mid off off his back foot.
Good length ball in line of the stumps, well blocked by Hetmyer.
Good running. It is important for these two to build a partnership here. Punches this ball to the off side and quickly gets to the other end.
Full on the pads, worked away to the on side.
FOUR! Poor ball and Hetmyer punishes it duly. A short ball on middle and leg from Hasan, Hetmyer rocks back and pulls it in the gap towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Picks up this fuller ball and drives it through mid off. Another run taken.
Covers his stumps, leans ahead and sees off this loopy ball.
Powell has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Guides this towards short third man for a run.
Sharp turn! Beauty from Mehidy. Gives this air around off, Hetmyer comes ahead and looks to block it. The ball turns sharply and almost gets the outside edge of his bat.
Mehidy Hasan is back for his final spell.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Good judgement! Taps a length ball to the cover-point region and calls his partner through for a brisk run.

Another case of a batsman mistiming a shot indicating that the track is two-paced. Short ball, comes off slowly after pitching. Powell mistimes his pull past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a couple.
Pitched up ball outside off, Powell drives it crisply to covers.
Length delivery around off, shaping in, Powell blocks it nicely towards the point region.

Good length ball around the leg stump, Shimron tries to flick it away but the ball brushes his pads and rolls towards fine leg. The batsmen set off for a run as Hossain starts appealing but bails out of it soon. The reason being it pitched outside leg. A leg bye is the result.

Loopy delivery, Shakib is varying his pace nicely. Powell lunges in defense. Only 2 from the over and 8 from the last three. These two batsmen need to keep the scoreboard ticking otherwise they might succumb to pressure.
Hetmyer is nimble on his feet as he punches this down the ground for a single.
Fuller in length on middle, milked down to long on to rotate strike.
Quicker one at 96 kph, hurries Powell as he defends it somehow off his front foot.
Slower through the air, sticks a bit on the surface. Powell is early into the push and the ball lobs for a while but it rolls safely down the track.
Straighter one on middle and off, pushed back to the bowler.
On a length outside off, Powell crouches and dabs it to third man for a single.
Fullish ball, angling in towards the pads, tucked through square leg for a single.
Fractionally overpitched on off, Hetmyer puts his head down and blocks it right under his eyes.
Back of a length outside off, glided down nicely to third man to change strike.
Pitched up ball outside off, Rovman taps it off the front foot to the cover region.

Almost knocked his partner out! Good reflexes from Hetmyer though. Short ball, Powell goes for the pull but mistimes it towards Shimron. He reacts in the nick of time to duck under it. The mid on fielder is alert as well and dives to his left to save a certain boundary for his side.
Coming in with the arm again, tucked to the mid-wicket region. A tidy over from Shakib, only 3 off it.
The slider from Shakib in line of the stumps, Powell tucks it off the inner half of the bat through backward square leg. A run taken.
Flatter and wider outside off, knocked down to long off for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Similar delivery, Powell shapes to cut this one away but is beaten by the pace. That was not far from the off pole.
Quicker through the air, punched off the back foot to the cover region.

Shoddy work! Powell taps this length ball towards cover-point and takes off. An unnecessary throw from the fielder results in a direct hit at the bowler's end but the batsman is already in. The ball deflects towards deep mid-wicket. The batsmen get another couple of runs.
Short ball again, Powell pulls but this time he finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Full length delivery, Rovman comes ahead to block it.

FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Short around off, sits up nicely for Powell. He stands tall and pulls it with aplomb through mid-wicket for a rocketing boundary. His first one of the innings, would help him to get a move on.
Back of a length ball around off, shaping in. Powell is tentative in his approach as he gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Slightly overpitched outside off, Shimron eases it through covers to rotate strike.
Shorter in length, kept out from the comfort of his crease.
Slower through the air, tapped gently with the spin to the cover region.
On a flatter trajectory on off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
As expected, Shakib bowls the arm ball. Rovman comes ahead and taps it to covers.
This one doesn't turn as much as Powell expects as he again leaves it. Got to watch for the straighter one.
Loopy ball outside off, spinning away. Powell sees it through safely.
Good call! On a length on off, helped towards mid on for a well-judged single and Powell gets off the mark.
Rovman Powell strides out to bat.

OUT! Another one goes down! It is Rubel who has produced the goods in his first over. Another partnership which had started to build up has been thrown away. Not a good short selection has resulted in his downfall. Back of a length ball outside off, angling in. Mohammed tries to flay it away through square of the wicket on the off side but there is no space to work with. An inside edge is induced and Rahim behind the stumps is safe as a house. The visitors continue to chip away at the wickets.
Back of a length ball outside off, played with an angled bat to the point region.
Harmless length ball on the hips, helped through square leg for an easy run.
Good length ball angling across Hetmyer. He has a poke at it but misses.

In the air... but safe! A well-directed short ball rising on Mohammed. He goes for the pull even though he is not in a good position and hence, a top edge results. The fine leg fielder hares to his left but the ball lands well in front of him. A run taken.
Rubel Hossain comes into the attack.
FOUR! Good placement from Hetmyer! Full delivery down the leg side, Shimron nails the sweep through the vacant fine leg region to find the fence. 9 from the over and 100 comes up for the Windies.
Fractionally short outside off, crunched to sweeper cover to change strike.
Mohammed tickles this one past short fine leg and returns for a brace.

There is a sense of urgency in the running and it is helping their cause. Full ball outside off, Jason slices it through cover-point and calls for two. A wayward throw from the deep allows the batsmen to make their ground with ease.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Ooh, an error in judgement from Mohammed! It it had slid on with the arm, Mohammed would have been a goner. Tossed up outside off, turns away a wee bit as Jason sees it just go past the off stump.
Fuller in length around off, tapped through mid on for a single.
Quicker one, Jason once again exposes his stumps and just about chops it towards extra cover.
Waits for this one and helps it around the corner for a single.
Nicely done! Picks the arm ball from Hossain and pulls it past mid-wicket for a couple.
Full and loopy ball outside off, eased off the front foot to covers.
Tossed up around off, kept out watchfully.
Makes use of the depth of the crease to milk a single down to long on.

That could have resulted into a suicidal run out! Hetmyer taps the loopy ball towards cover-point and sets off initially. His partner responds but the left-hander stutters and stops. He eventually sends his partner back and goes back himself as well. No harm done in the end.
Hetmyer turns this one with the spin towards square leg and looks for a run but there is none on offer.
This one slides on with the arm, punched off the back foot to extra cover.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
Loopy delivery, Shimron hangs back and punches it down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Too full and down leg, Mohammed goes for the slog sweep and gets enough on it. The fielder at short fine leg dives to his right but the ball goes past him for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Casual stuff from Hossain! Full ball outside off, Hetmyer pushes this one towards the right side of the bowler. He takes it easily and allows the ball to go towards long off. A run taken.
The flatter trajectory on this one and the shorter length allows Hetmyer to rock back and cut it through point. A brace results.
Hangs back and punches the shorter one out.
On middle and leg, tucked to mid on.
Slower through the air, kept out watchfully. A wicket and 3 from the over.
Tossed up ball, defended solidly off the front foot.
Jason Mohammed comes out to bat.

OUT! The wily Shakib strikes! He sets him up beautifully by bowling the previous one quicker and then catches the batsman off guard by bowling this one slower. He also does the smart thing to drag his length back and land this one a bit wider. It comes off slowly from the pitch. Hope is early into his push and ends up mistiming it towards short extra cover. Sabbir Rahman gets low and takes a neat catch in front of him. Hope had started to bat better but his innings has been nipped in the bud.
That's a peach! Shakib bowls this one wider of the crease and gives this one a lot of revs. After landing, the ball turns and bounces away to go past the hanging bat of Hope. He had no clue about it.
On the pads once again, helped to the leg side to rotate strike.

Good running! Drifting towards middle and leg, Shimron works it through square leg and runs the first one hand. Seeing the fielder misfield, he calls his partner through for another run and makes his ground with ease.

Good fielding! Hope plays this against the spin towards point. Hetmyer is sent for a run but Hope sends him back. The fielder attacks the ball and throws it at the bowler's end but the batsman is safely in.
Hope leans ahead and taps it with the spin to short mid-wicket.
On middle and leg, worked towards short fine leg for a brisk run.
Spinning in nicely this time, turned around the corner for an easy run.

FOUR! Close shave! That was a brute of a ball. Pitches around off, grips and straightens to hurry Hope up. He hangs his bat in anticipation but gets an outside edge past the keeper and through to the fence. Mehidy has been right on the money today.

On the shorter side and slow through the air on middle and off, Hetmyer goes for a pull but mistimes his through square leg for a run. He has a look of anguish on his face as he could have connected it better.
Time for Drinks!
On a shorter length outside off, tapped off the back foot towards covers. Good start from Shakib, only 2 from his first over.

Had there been a wide first slip as there was for Hetmyer, it could have gone straight into his hands. Shakib has his hands on his head. Loopy ball outside off, spinning away. Shai tries to defend it off the front foot but gets an outside edge towards short third man.
Slower through the air, Hope leans ahead and defends it calmly.
Spinning in nicely, Hetmyer stays deep in the crease and punches it through wide mid off for a run.
Tossed up ball, defended solidly off the front foot.
Spinning away from outside off, punched with the spin through covers for a run.
Shakib Al Hasan comes on for a bowl.
Drifting in towards middle and leg, turned through square leg for a run.
The batsman drives this through the covers. They pick up a single.
Ooh, Hetmyer is living dangerously! Spinning in and staying low, Shimron exposes his stumps and just manages to chop it away.
Spinning in sharply, Hetmyer rocks back and cuts it through cover-point. Some aggressive running between the wickets allows the batsmen to come back for a couple.
Tossed up ball, pushed off the front foot to mid off.

That was a loud, loud shout! Tossed up ball around off, gripping and turning in sharply. Hope prods forward to defend but misses to get hit on the pads as the ball rolls to the off side and the batsmen set off. Hasan is very confident but the umpire stays put. Mortaza has a look at his bowler but doesn't take the review. Reckon that was doing too much.
Flicked away to the deep square leg region to end the over with a single.
Pushes this ball towards covers straight to the fielder.
Fuller ball down the leg side, Hetmyer works it towards square leg for a run.
Hope guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Stays back and drives another one, this time though to the fielder at cover.
Sweet! But will only get two for it. Drives this in the gap to the fielder at extra cover for a couple of runs.
Goes onto his back foot and punches it to the off side. Another successful over from Hasan.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shimron Hetmyer is the new man in. A wide first slip in place for him.

OUT! The bowling change has done the trick and Bangladesh have their second. Slower one on middle and leg, Gayle gets on one knee and looks to sweep this. Plays against the turn, not a good option that, his one hand comes off the handle and he cannot get bat to ball. Gets hit on his pads and the umpire does not hesitate to give him out. No reviews left for the hosts and Gayle walks back in disappointment as he once again got his eye in but couldn't convert. Even if there was a review left and had it been taken, it wouldn't have mattered as the replays show three reds. The Bangladeshis are ecstatic.
Chris plays it with an angled bat and guides it to the short third man fielder.
Smart bowling from Hasan, lands this on middle, Gayle defends it.
Gayle covers his stumps and blocks this ball.
Mehidy Hasan is back on.
Hope defends it from within the crease and shouts a loud 'NOOOO' to his partner.
FOUR! Textbook cover drive. Fuller ball outside off, it sits up nicely for Hope who leans forward and drives it through extra cover for a boundary.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
How did that miss? An off cutter from the Fizz on middle and it comes into Gayle who cannot get bat to ball. The ball goes just over the stumps. A very good take from the keeper.
Similar ball, Gayle gets behind the ball and hits it to the off side as his one hand comes off the handle.
Length ball outside off, punched to the off side.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.

FOUR! 50 up for the Windies. Hope finally gets a boundary after struggling for a while. Hossain gives this air outside off, Shai gets low and slog sweeps it over the square leg region. No fielder there in the deep and the ball meets the fence.
Misfield and Windies will get bonus runs. Tossed up ball outside off, Hope gets low and drives it towards covers. The fielder there cannot get his hands to it and the batsmen steal a couple of runs.
Hangs back again and plays it with a straight bat towards mid on for one more.
Finds the gap this time. Rocks back and pulls it to cow corner for a single.
Plays this with the turn and helps it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Mosaddek Hossain to roll his arm.
Chris shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length ball on off, Hope punches this ball through covers for a run.
Tucks this ball around the corner to rotate strike.
CG has punched that ball through the off side.
FOUR! Opening his shoulders now. Rahman bangs this one short on leg, Gayle gives himself room and pulls it with disdain over mid-wicket. The ball has crossed the ropes. The umpire signals a boundary.
Just away from the fielder at mid-wicket. Fuller one from Rahman, Gayle flicks it aerially towards that region just away from the diving Mehidy for a brace.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. 4 fielders can now stand outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Also, Mustafizur Rahman is introduced into the attack.
Quicker one on the pads, helped to the square leg fielder. Windies 34/1 after Powerplay 1.
Short ball on off, cut to the point region.
Gayle has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Waits for the ball to turn and plays it with the spin through mid-wicket for one.
Follows Gayle and serves this down leg. Gayle throws the kitchen sink at it but gets it off the inner half towards mid on for one.
Quicker one on middle, Gayle strides forward and blocks it onto the ground.
Just the one from the over and Hope is on 1 run from 15 balls. Waits for the ball to come to him and hits it to the point region.
This is not good from Hope. He needs to at least rotate the strike. Punches this ball to the off side for nothing.
Length ball outside off, Hope thinks of cutting it but leaves it at the last moment.
Serves this full on the leg stump, Hope works it to the square leg fielder.
Flicks this ball in the gap to give Hope the strike.
Fullish ball outside off, driven uppishly to the cover-point fielder.
Another maiden from Hasan. Some very good bowling to put pressure on the hosts. Quicker one on the pads, flicked away to the square leg fielder.
Five dots. Hasan is not giving any room to Hope. Darts this one full in line of the stumps, Hope plays it onto the ground.
Four dots again. This is great bowling from Hasan. Hope cannot find the gap and hits this ball back to the bowler.
Strides forward and closes the bat face to help it to the leg side.
Off spinner on middle and leg, worked away to the mid-wicket region.
Fuller one on leg, flicked away to the on side.
Hope opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single. Good over from the skipper, just a run and the important wicket of Lewis from it.
Outside off, Hope shoulders his arm to it.
Hope chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Gets behind the ball and plays it in front of him.
Back of a length ball on off, cut away to the cover-point region.
Shai Hope comes out to bat.

OUT! Plumb! A very good decision from the umpire. Mortaza bowls this on a good length around off, Lewis is caught hanging on his back foot and looks to work this to the leg side. The ball comes quickly onto him and raps him on the front leg. The bowler appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Lewis consults his partner and takes the review but Hawk Eye shows us three reds. No 1000 runs for Evin today either and Windies lose their review as well.
An LBW decision has been referred upstairs.
SIX! 10 off the last two balls. And Gayle who was taking singles in the first game is playing how Gayle plays. Makes room once again and lofts this ball easily over mid on for a maximum.
FOUR! No he can't! Darts another one full and down leg, Gayle makes room and hits it straight back along the turf past mid on for a boundary.
That's 10 dots balls in a row from him. Not giving any room to the left-hander to play with. Darts this full and straight, Gayle is solid in his defense. Can he get back-to-back maidens?
Presents the full face of the bat and taps the ball in front of him. Another great start from the spinner.
Straighter one on middle, Gayle comes forward and blocks it well.
Hint of turn. Served on middle and off, Gayle prods forward but doesn't get behind the ball.
Slower ball, 110 kph, Gayle reads it well and plays it with soft hands to the point region for a sharp single.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched to the cover region.
And now rotates the strike. Sensible. Turns his bat to the leg side to get to the other end.
After the big hit, there is an issue with the ball. The umpires are having a close look at it and call the fourth umpire for a change of the ball.

SIX! The first one of the day. Once again the question of why did Bangladesh field first arises. The only reason I can see is that there is a possibility of rain. Mortaza bangs this one short on middle and leg, Lewis waits for it and pulls it over square leg for a biggie.
Gayle works this around the corner for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Darts this one full on middle and leg, Lewis looks to flick it away but gets hit on his pads. The fielders appeal but that was going down leg. Great over from Hasan. Maiden from him.
Outside off, Lewis see it through to the keeper.
Ohh! That kept a shade low. Bowls another quicker one in line of the stumps, Lewis does well to get bat to ball.

An appeal for an LBW turned down! Quicker one around leg stump, Lewis goes for the sweep but misses to get struck on the pads. A shout from the bowling side but the umpire turns it down. Probably sliding down leg.
Quicker ball outside off, Lewis goes for the cut but gets an bottom edge back to the bowler.
Loopy ball on off, played to covers. Dot ball.
Good end to the over. Just two from it. Gayle stays in his crease and sees this ball off. 10/0 after 3 overs.
Good length ball on middle and leg, pushed back towards the bowler.
Once again good running. Plays this with soft hands towards covers and hares to complete the run. Good understanding between the duo.
Serves this on that fifth stump channel, Lewis plays it with a straight bat.
On a good length around off, played to the off side by Lewis.
Good running. Gayle taps this ball to the off side and quickly responds to his partner's call. Lewis is running to the danger end and makes it home comfortably.
Quicker one in line of the stumps, Lewis is happy to block it.
FOUR! And after four dot balls, Lewis decides to take him on. Hasan overpitches this on middle and off, Lewis gets under the ball and lofts it over mid off to the fence.
Gives this air on leg, Lewis goes for the sweep but cannot make any contact. Good over so far from Hasan.
Short ball outside off, cut very late by Lewis to the backward point fielder.
Quicker one on middle and leg, hit for the mid-wicket fielder to collect.
Flatter one around off, played towards mid on for nothing.
Mehidy Hasan will bowl with the second new ball.
Back of a length around off, pushed to covers to end the over.
Full again outside off, well blocked by Chris.
Fuller this time on off, Gayle pushes it back towards the bowler.
Good comeback. On a good length on that fourth stump line. Gayle doesn't move his feet and does not make any contact with the ball.

FOUR! After a lovely ball he follows it up with  a poor one. Overpitches this and gives the big man a half volley on his legs. All Gayle has to do is get bat to it. He flicks it away through square leg for the first boundary.
Great way to start. Comes in from over the wicket and lands it on a good length around off. Forces Gayle to play at it and almost gets his outside edge.

The umpires and the players have made their way out. The sky looks nice and clear and we hope it stays that way. Chris Gayle and Evin Lewis will open for the hosts while the pick of the bowlers, Mashrafe Mortaza, will bowl with the first new ball. A slip in place for him.

Windies skipper, Jason Holder says that they would have liked to bowl first as well. Mentions that it seems to be a good wicket and they will look to bat well. States that they need to play well in all three departments. Informs there is one forced change - Andre Russell has an injury and Keemo Paul gets a game in his place.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza says that they are going to bowl this time. Mentions that it rained overnight and feels that there will be moisture on the pitch. Adds that they want to restrict them and chase the total down. States that he backs his decision to field first and hopes it will be a good one. Ends by saying that they are playing with the same team.
Toss - Bangladesh win the toss and opt to field.

Pitch report - Jeff Dujon assessing the surface says that there are a lot of cracks on it and the foundation is not firm enough. He inspects and says that there is dampness on the track due to the overnight rain. He adds saying that there will be sticky bounce but things will get better for batting. Win the toss and bowl first he reckons.

Hello and a warm welcome to our coverage of the 2nd ODI between Windies and Bangladesh. The visitors seem to prefer the colored clothing and they showed it to us in the previous game. Their big name players came to the party when it mattered and it is now time for the Men in Maroon to shine at home. They have all it needs to win in the white-ball format with even bigger names. The hosts will look to bounce back after the first game and take it all the way to the decider. We hope the rain stays away and also the game is a cracker cause this is going to keep us, fans in India, awake. Toss and team news in a while.
